newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australis appoints new chief exec.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australis appoints new chief exec.

text.p: Pay television operator Australis Media Ltd said on Thursday it appointed former MovieVision and Seven Network executive Sean O'Halloran as chief executive.
He replaces Neil Gamble who joined Sydney Harbour Casino Ltd in October.
Australis said O'Halloran was most recently chief executive of MovieVision Pty Ltd, which provides movie programming to OptusVision. He was previously with Seven Network Ltd.
Acting chief executive Larry Carleton would contine as chief operating officer, Australis said.
